text:
Maya: @channel :rotating_light: incident-bot paging failures — several on-call missed pages. Customer reports of delayed alerts. Anyone seeing delivery errors?

ops-bot: INCIDENTBOT ALERT: delivery failure for /pagerflow/webhook -> 504 gateway timeout; 8 retries queued

Jun: I'm seeing 504s from notify-proxy to pagerflow in the logs, connection reset from upstream. Queue depth jumping.

Priya: Paging queue backlog spiked; can confirm manual failover didn't run. signing-rotation logs show intermittent 401s around the same time.

Sam: I'm oncall, didn't get a page. Had to manual page via SMS/phone :phone:. No page in channel.

Maya: @support any customer impact details? We need to know scope.

Nina: Support: two customers reported delayed/incomplete escalations — AcmeCorp and ByteBox. They report 7-12 minute delay before they got notified. No data loss, but missed SLA windows.

Jun: I'll try scaling notify-proxy now and check redis connections. Scaling + rolling restart might relieve backpressure.

Priya: Hold — suspect signing key rotation + transient 401s caused incidentbot retries to pile into the queue, exacerbating the backlog.

Sam: Can we flip incidentbot to the fallback endpoint (/pager/legacy) while we stabilize?

Maya: Jun — please scale to +2 replicas and flush auth cache. I'll orchestrate manual pages and notify customers.

Jun: running: `kubectl scale deploy/notify-proxy --replicas=5` — will monitor.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: notify-proxy scaled to 5 replicas by Jun

Priya: cleared auth cache and restarted signing-rotation worker: `./scripts/clear-auth-cache.sh && systemctl restart signing-rotator`

Nina: Support: AcmeCorp confirms they got pages again ~3m after manual SMS. ByteBox confirmed resolution as well but unhappy about SLA.

Sam: Filing SEV-3 for automation regression and missed escalations. Assigning to eng-oncall.

Maya: Action items: 1) temporary alert on notify-proxy queue depth, 2) add automatic fallback to /pager/legacy, 3) run signing-rotation integration test, 4) postmortem and runbook update. I'll schedule postmortem.

Jun: Adding alert: `if notify_proxy.queue_depth > 500 for 5m -> fire` and will wire it to oncall.

Priya: I'll add tests for signing-rotation and ensure 401s don't cause infinite retries.

Maya: Thanks all. We'll capture customer impact in the SEV timeline and follow up with communications.
